title.narrative: "Zambian women advancing out of poverty and GBV"

description.narrative:
The Women empowerment and business expansion project is for three years and aims to support 1600 rural Zambian women to move out of poverty and situations of GBV by being organised in 55 VSLAs linked to a revolving fund from start and by participating in monthly monthly meetings with trainings in gender equality, women's rights and business management. The women are supported to start a small business and to expand and further develop their businesses over a period of 3 to 5 years depending on when their VSLA was started. The project also aims to strenghten the capacity of the implementing Zambian CSO Women for Change to become an effective actor in supporting women's enconomic empowerment. The overall objectives are that: 1.Rural women living in poverty and vulnerability have gained increased agency and capacity to move out of poverty and GBV. 2. Earlier contribution to the project was a three year pilot phase from 2023 - 2025 funded by The Foundation Support for Development.
